title: Prove exact positive-Q8 class-count frontiers and weighted tariffs
body:
## Summary

Closes the positive-Q8 weighted-price obligation left by PR3487. For a negative pair or two-negative/one-positive triple with any finite restored dirty workspace, the complete Pareto-minimal i/j count vectors are

```text
(s_i, s_j+4), (s_i+2, s_j+2), (s_i+4, s_j)
minimum bill = alpha*s_i + beta*s_j + 4*min(alpha,beta)
```

The prices are arbitrary nonnegative reals, including zero. A separate exactly-three-role, three-negative corollary has four vectors and sign surcharge `6*min(alpha,beta)`. No extra-workspace claim is made for that third family.

Separate label-rank floors and trace parity turn the retained unit minima into domination of every legal count vector, including arbitrarily long words. Squaring either generator on the negative coordinates attains every frontier vector. This is a new count/weighted corollary; PR3487 and PR3471 retain the unit-minimum credit.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3487 proves universal unit minima six and seven but explicitly leaves nonuniform prices unclaimed. PR3471 supplies the finite three-negative, three-role nine-call result.
- **After:** PROOF.md gives the unbounded domination argument. The registered CPython 3.12 replay checks 212 endpoints, 644 frontier words, 2,120 exact rational price cases, 153,280 dirty columns, 4,464 omissions, 60,608 integer domination cases and 10,666 first-order equations. A separate action engine checks another 5,078 generic words and 106,792 dirty columns. Four optimized behavioral groups reject actual producer, action, source and scope faults.

The exact eighteen-file PR3487 proof/replay closure is retained unchanged, with original paths, blobs, SHA256 and notices. Its native exclusions and constructive reduction replay unchanged. The two largest complete membership streams still use one native implementation. The original failed correlated-mutation control and its correction are documented. Strict native diagnostics, Ruff, final committed-byte/source-history and Git-free replay receipts accompany publication.

Reproduce with `python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/q8-two-negative-weighted`, using a private external TMPDIR and a C++20 compiler. Canonical baseline is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision 6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19010612).

Credit also remains with Tuafo/PR2900, ywz65/PR2587, PR3450/3460, Aaron Wang/PR2318 and the retained register-model lineage. Arham Tahir/PR3137 and PR3461 have separate physical compiler/preparation contracts.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

All changes are under `research/q8-two-negative-weighted/`. No selected frontier, frozen predecessor or shared tool changes. General three-negative workspace, independently priced signed labels, physical caller/hosting/precision, full supplier invoice and new kappa remain unclaimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
